title: Birthday Problem: Threshold for 99% Match Probability

problemStatement.formal: P(57) > 99/100 and P(56) < 99/100 where P(n) = 1 - 365!/((365-n)! · 365^n). Hence 57 is the exact threshold for 99% birthday match probability.
problemStatement.plain: Prove that exactly 57 people are needed for a 99% probability of at least two sharing a birthday (with 365 days).
whyMatters: Natural extension of the famous 23-person 50% threshold
Exact computation requires careful rational arithmetic
Demonstrates formal verification of probabilistic threshold computations

proven: 57 is the exact threshold for 99% birthday match probability
